integrated_multimodal_description:
This is a standard vertical 9:16 portrait video. The sky must be at the very top of the frame, the ground and crowds at the very bottom. The frame is NOT rotated — the horizon stays perfectly level and horizontal, gravity points straight down, and the camera is held upright, never tilted sideways. Absolutely forbidden: horizontal composition, any 90-degree rotation of the frame, sideways or tilted ground, a tilted horizon, the sky appearing at the side of the frame, or vertical pillars rendered lying horizontally. [Shot 1] Cinematic Chinese celestial palace aesthetic, ethereal xianxia realm, cold blue-gray low-saturation environment with high-saturation warm accents. The scene is a suspended bronze dual-furnace workshop floating above a sea of mist, featuring strict central-axis symmetry. In the medium shot, a fictional xianxia character in flowing vermilion robes stands on the central cloud terrace between two colossal bronze furnaces, their mouths facing each other. The camera executes a slow push-in (the composition itself unfolds left-to-right within the frame) with small amplitude at slow speed, simulating a lateral traverse from the left furnace to the right. Foreground bronze textures with intricate spiritual engravings blur past the edges, creating a dynamic framing effect. From 0 to 3.8 seconds, cyan and gold spiritual flames erupt simultaneously from both furnaces, intertwining in the air to form a twisting vortex of light. Between 3.8 and 7.7 seconds, the flame centers condense into a translucent hexagonal crystal material that rises slowly; sharp refracted light from the crystal sweeps across the immortal's side profile and the rough stone walls, highlighting the contrast between cold ambient light and warm firelight. From 7.7 to 11.5 seconds, the crystal descends onto the cloud terrace, where an un-awakened mechanical spirit puppet raises its arm to catch it; the puppet's joints glow with soft spiritual light as the immortal nods slightly. The immortal's silk sleeves and the furnace flames flutter in the same direction, emphasizing synchronized harmony. The visuals play as off-screen voiceover narration while lips remain completely closed. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions.

overall_soundscape:
A deep, resonant hum of celestial energy mixes with the crackling roar of dual spiritual flames. Soft, ethereal wind sweeps through the clouds, accompanied by the subtle shimmer of refracting light and the gentle, precise click of mechanical joints engaging. The atmosphere is serene yet powerful, with a low-frequency drone that fades into a misty silence as the scene concludes.
